item.title: Python Tip of the Week: When NumPy Isn’t Enough — Try SymPy
item.description:
Most of us reach for NumPy whenever math shows up in a project. But sometimes, you don’t want approximate answers. You want exact math. That’s when SymPy taps you on the shoulder and whispers: “I’ve got this.”

Concrete examples where “close enough” isn’t good enough:

  • Computing interest rates in finance where pennies matter.
  • Physics simulations where rounding errors accumulate into nonsense results.
  • Checking algebraic identities where 0.0000001 should really be 0.
